title: CoM$^3$eT: A foundation model for medical image analysis through federated, multidimensional context integration
abstract: arXiv:2608.16268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical foundation models improve generalization when training AI models with limited labeled data, but remain confined to a single specialty, such as pathology or radiology, and to either sparse or dense outputs, such as classification or segmentation. Here, we present CoM$^3$eT (Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer), a medical vision foundation model that unifies pathology and radiology, sparse and dense predictions, and two- and higher-dimensional inputs by modeling multidimensional context with attention. CoM$^3$eT outperformed other medical foundation models in an open competition spanning five tomographic, four whole-specimen, and three two-dimensional datasets, covering sparse and dense prediction tasks as well as report generation. translated_title: CoM$^3$eT：一种通过联邦式、多维度上下文整合的医学图像分析基础模型
translated_abstract: 医学基础模型在有限标注数据下训练AI模型时能提升泛化能力，但仍局限于单一专业领域（如病理学或放射学），且仅支持稀疏或密集输出（如分类或分割）。在此，我们提出了CoM$^3$eT（协同表示多维多任务医学Transformer），这是一种医学视觉基础模型，通过注意力机制建模多维度上下文，统一了病理学与放射学、稀疏与密集预测、以及二维和更高维度输入。CoM$^3$eT在涵盖五个断层扫描、四个全标本和三个二维数据集的开放竞赛中，超越了其他医学基础模型，覆盖了稀疏和密集预测任务以及报告生成。在适应多种临床应用时，仅训练少于2.5%的参数即可达到与全量微调相当的性能，使无需全面微调的研究成为可能。
tldr: 该论文提出CoM$^3$eT，一个通过多维度上下文整合统一病理与放射、稀疏与密集预测及多维度输入的医学基础模型，以极低参数微调即可达到全量微调性能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CoM$^3$eT, a medical foundation model that unifies pathology and radiology, sparse and dense predictions, and multi-dimensional inputs via multidimensional context integration, achieving full fine-tuning performance with fewer than 2.5% of parameters trained.
